Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to each side’s acceptance objective. On completion the DA states that side’s commitments and known reservations plainly. A shared reference permits simple terms; complex terms need adequate translation. No side accepts impossible terms, and the agreement is not magical enforcement.

nodes.name: Steady Voice I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. One willing ally within 4 squares who hears and understands your reassurance reduces Frightened by 1. No roll.

nodes.name: Steady Voice II
nodes.effect: Steady Voice reduces Frightened by 2.

nodes.name: Steady Voice III
nodes.effect: Steady Voice affects two willing allies within range.

nodes.name: Rally the Line I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Up to three willing allies within 6 squares who perceive and understand your signal reduce Frightened by 2. One of them may also move 1 square toward you without movement reactions. No roll.

nodes.name: Rally the Line II
nodes.effect: Rally the Line can affect four allies.

nodes.name: Rally the Line III
nodes.effect: Each ally affected by Rally the Line may move 1 square toward you without movement reactions.

nodes.name: Hold the Company Together
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Once per scene, up to four willing allies within 6 squares who perceive and understand you reduce Frightened and Dazed by 2 each, gain 1 Boon on their next defense before your next turn starts, and may move 2 squares toward you without movement reactions. This grants no additional actions or Reactions. No roll.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. When a listener who understands you challenges your account or questions your distraction, answer before its response resolves; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s deception objective. Once per distinct challenge per exchange. You may also present an ordinary plausible false account during an exchange using the same progress; repetition and impossible claims earn no progress.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder II
nodes.effect: Plausible Rejoinder adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Plausible Rejoinder III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, a relevant prepared prop or corroborating witness adds 1 extra progress to Plausible Rejoinder.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention I
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. When up to three listeners within 6 squares who understand you begin to turn attention from your ongoing plausible distraction, renew it with a new detail before they act. Add 1/2/3 progress toward holding their attention for one minute. On completion allies gain 1 Boon on unnoticed tasks outside those listeners’ direct sight for that minute. Once per distinct interruption; you may also begin this distraction through an ordinary exchange.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention II
nodes.effect: Hold Their Attention adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention III
nodes.effect: Hold Their Attention can engage five listeners; an immediate obvious danger ends its distraction.

nodes.name: Turn the Conversation
nodes.effect: Reaction · Guile. Once per conversation, when a revealed fact would end your plausible distraction or false account, introduce a prepared alternative explanation before the listeners react. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to up to four listeners’ separate objectives for accepting it. Each completed objective keeps that listener engaged for one minute, giving allies 2 Boons on unnoticed tasks outside its sight during that time. Contradictory proof and impossible explanations cannot be talked away; direct danger ends the distraction.

nodes.name: Draw the Line I
nodes.effect: One exchange · Brawn. State a credible immediate consequence you can carry out to a listener who perceives and understands the threat; add 1/2/3 progress toward a limited concession established by the DA.

nodes.name: Draw the Line II
nodes.effect: Draw the Line adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Draw the Line III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, demonstrating the threatened capability without attacking the listener adds 1 extra progress to Draw the Line.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Offer a feasible surrender to up to three enemies who understand you. Roll once; add 1/2/3 progress to their shared objective if they share a motive, otherwise to one chosen enemy’s objective. They continue acting until an objective completes.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender II
nodes.effect: Terms of Surrender adds 1/3/4 progress.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender III
nodes.effect: Terms of Surrender can address six enemies with a shared motive; otherwise choose one as before.

nodes.name: A Way to Yield
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Once per scene, offer a credible, immediately available path out of a losing conflict to up to six enemies who understand you: surrender under stated protection, withdraw through an open route, or release captives for safe passage. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to their shared objective if their motives align, otherwise one chosen enemy’s objective. On completion they accept the established concession while you honor its terms. This grants no automatic ceasefire before completion and no control over independent allies.

nodes.name: Elements
nodes.effect: Shape the physical world: heat, water, stone and air.

nodes.name: Life
nodes.effect: Restore, transform, cultivate and unravel living things.

nodes.name: Mentalism
nodes.effect: Thought, feeling, perception and the dreaming mind.

nodes.name: Divination
nodes.effect: Find what is hidden across distance, history and possibility.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.effect: Contact beings, establish bonds and cross boundaries.

nodes.name: Force
nodes.effect: Move, shape, animate and enchant the material world.

nodes.name: Wards
nodes.effect: Protect people and places; secure and unravel magic.

nodes.name: Spellcraft
nodes.effect: Study your reserves, restore your focus and channel magical power.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by 2.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 2; this path now grants +4 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +7 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +10 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +13 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Deep Reserves III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +16 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Soul Wellspring
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 4; this path now grants +20 maximum SP. Once between safe overnight rests, when you spend SP to cast a spell, you may pay up to 2 of its SP from this reserve without reducing current SP. Declare the amount before casting; any unused part of that one payment is lost, not saved for another spell. This grants no additional casting or current-SP recovery.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by 2.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 2; this path now grants +4 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +7 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind I
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +10 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind II
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +13 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Ordered Mind III
nodes.effect: Increase maximum SP by another 3; this path now grants +16 maximum SP.

nodes.name: Mind Palace
nodes.effect: Passive. Increase maximum SP by another 4; this path now grants +20 maximum SP. Once between safe overnight rests, when you begin a ritual you have learned, reduce its total printed SP cost by 2, minimum 0. For a ritual with daily payments, reduce only its first payment. Declare before beginning; interruption still spends that benefit. Work time, materials and other requirements remain.

nodes.name: Recovery I
nodes.effect: 1 uninterrupted hour of safe rest, meditation or quiet leisure. Once between safe overnight rests, recover 1 SP. This can occur during permitted quiet rest time; ordinary overnight recovery remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Recovery II
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 2 SP in total.

nodes.name: Recovery III
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 3 SP in total.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal I
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 4 SP in total. Learning this step does not grant another use if that rest has already been used.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal II
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 6 SP in total.

nodes.name: Quiet Renewal III
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 8 SP in total.

nodes.name: Perfect Repose
nodes.effect: The same single recovery rest restores 12 SP in total and takes 30 uninterrupted minutes of safe rest or quiet leisure instead of an hour. It remains once between safe overnight rests and does not count as a safe overnight rest. No Grit, first-aid allowance or other limited use is refreshed.

nodes.name: Stormsteel Arc
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn · 3 SP, with a melee weapon. Sweep lightning through up to three visible enemies within 3 squares. Roll once; each takes 3/6/9 lightning damage. On Strong, each also gains Dazed 1. This is a new magical attack, not a use of Measured Cut; its improvements do not apply.

nodes.name: The Invisible Shieldbearer
nodes.effect: Reaction · 2 SP, with a held shield. When an ally within 8 squares is about to take damage from an attack, project a force barrier to it. Reduce that attack’s damage by 4, minimum 1, then move the willing ally up to 2 squares along a legal route without movement reactions. This protects against one attack only and requires no additional roll.

nodes.name: Borrowed Dawn
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 4 SP. Restore 8/12/16 HP to one living willing, Dying or stabilized creature within reach. Also reduce its Bleeding by 2. This is magical healing, not first aid: it neither spends nor refreshes the recipient’s first-aid allowance. It cannot raise the dead, restore Grit or exceed maximum HP. Apply each recipient’s Life resistance, with at least 1 HP restored when HP is missing.

nodes.name: Starfall Volley
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility · 4 SP, with a ranged weapon. Attack up to three visible enemies within 12 squares whose visible defenses you studied with a Main Action earlier this scene. Spend one projectile per target and roll once; each takes 4/7/10 fire damage and Burning 1. Each target is struck once; allies and other creatures nearby are unaffected. This grants no bonus to other attacks.

nodes.name: Step Between Heartbeats
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility · 4 SP, with a melee weapon. Teleport to a visible unoccupied square within 10 squares, then attack one adjacent creature for 4/7/10 physical damage. After the attack, teleport up to 4 squares to another visible legal destination. Neither teleport triggers movement reactions. If you finish behind cover that conceals you from every enemy, become Hidden. An explicit teleportation barrier can block either movement.

nodes.name: Sanctuary of Steel
nodes.effect: Main Action · 4 SP, wearing armor and holding a shield. Create a fixed sanctuary within 3 squares of your position until your next turn ends. You and up to four chosen allies inside it reduce attack damage by 4, minimum 1, and cannot gain Frightened or Dazed while inside. Existing conditions remain. Leaving ends a creature’s protection until it returns; the boundary blocks neither movement nor attacks. Recasting replaces your previous sanctuary.

nodes.name: Colossus of the Forge
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP, with a melee weapon. Form an incandescent shell around yourself through the end of your next turn, then immediately sweep up to four enemies within 3 squares for 4/7/10 physical damage and Burning 1, using one roll. While the shell lasts, gain Stability 3 and reduce attack damage by 3, minimum 1. On your next turn, you may spend a Main Action to repeat that sweep without additional SP. The shell cannot stack with another copy and creates no lasting material.

nodes.name: The Road for the Lost
nodes.effect: Ritual · 10 minutes · 6 SP. Open a visible passage from your position to a landmark on the same plane within 100 squares that you personally visited and surveyed. Both endpoints must have safe, unoccupied footing. Up to twelve willing creatures you name may cross during the next minute; no other creature or attack can pass through it. You may close it early with a Maneuver. It transports carried belongings but no unattended freight. Teleportation barriers block the working; it does not bypass an unknown destination or create safe ground.

nodes.name: Dawn on the Battlefield
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP. Choose up to six living willing, Dying or stabilized allies within 6 squares whom you can see. Roll once; each restores 6/10/14 HP and reduces Bleeding and Frightened by 2 each. A Dying or stabilized ally need not respond to be included. This is magical healing and neither uses nor refreshes first-aid allowances. It cannot raise the dead, restore Grit or exceed maximum HP. Each recipient is affected once per use. Apply each recipient’s Life resistance, with at least 1 HP restored when HP is missing.

nodes.name: Meteor Swarm
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP. Choose up to three visible points within 12 squares. Roll once; every creature within 1 square of a chosen point takes 4/7/10 fire damage. A creature in overlapping areas takes damage once. Allies are not exempt. Unattended flammable objects ignite. This is one spell, not three separate castings.

nodes.name: Wall of Thorns — Living Fortress
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason · 5 SP. Raise up to eight connected thorn-wall squares on unoccupied ground within 8 squares. The walls last 10 minutes, are 2 squares high, block movement and provide cover. Name up to six creatures when casting; each may pass through at normal movement cost. Other creatures can spend a Main Action cutting through one adjacent square with a suitable edged tool, taking 3 physical damage before resistance. Fire destroys an affected wall square after that attack resolves. No roll. Damage from cutting thorns is environmental, so resistance may reduce it to 0.

nodes.name: True Resurrection
nodes.effect: Ritual · 8 uninterrupted hours · Reason · 8 SP, with remains of one person dead no longer than seven days and unique funerary materials worth 500 coins. The DA establishes availability before preparation. The spirit must freely agree. At completion, consume the materials and return that person to life at 1 HP in a restored body, clearing both death roll tallies but retaining descriptive scars. No roll. No duplicate body, restored Grit or SP is created. Each person has one lifetime return to life, shared with Lifegiving and Mass Lifegiving. This ritual restores a life ended before its natural span.

nodes.name: Simulacrum
nodes.effect: Ritual · 8 uninterrupted hours · Knowledge · 8 SP, with a willing adjacent living model and sculpting materials worth 300 coins, consumed on completion. Create one likeness with 10 HP, no SP or Grit, your Speed, and the model’s appearance and voice. It lasts until destroyed or you create another. It cannot cast, use learned abilities or recover HP. On your turn, spend a Main Action to command it to move up to its Speed and perform an ordinary task or Basic Melee attack using your Knowledge and 2/3/5 damage. It has no independent actions or Reactions; you roll its defenses with your attributes. It cannot create a duplicate. Destroying it does not harm the model. This mastery and the Animation book’s Simulacrum share one likeness allowance; creating either ends the other.

nodes.name: Demiplane
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 hour · Knowledge · 6 SP. Open a doorway on an adjacent solid wall to your private 6-by-6-square refuge, 3 squares high. The doorway lasts 10 minutes and may be used by anyone who can reach it. You may close it with a Maneuver. A Maneuver inside opens an exit to the last entrance location; if obstructed, use the nearest unoccupied square within 3 squares. The refuge holds ordinary objects and up to twelve creatures, with air and normal time but no created food or water. You have one refuge; recasting reopens it from the new wall. It grants no travel to any other destination. No roll.

nodes.name: Foresight — Shared Vigil
nodes.effect: Ritual · 10 minutes · Reason · 5 SP. Link yourself and up to three willing creatures within 3 squares for one hour. Linked creatures within 12 squares of you receive a warning when any linked member perceives a threat. If the warning alerts the group before the attack, roll initiative normally. Once each round, after one linked creature rolls a defense, it may reroll the entire roll and keep either result. The entire group shares this one reroll. The link carries warnings, not unrestricted thoughts. Recasting replaces the previous link. No roll.

nodes.name: Storm of Vengeance
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason · 7 SP. Choose a visible point within 12 squares and a 1-square sanctuary within 2 squares of that point. For three rounds, a storm fills a 3-square radius around the point. When cast, roll once: creatures in the storm outside the sanctuary take 3/5/7 lightning damage. On each of your next two turns, you may spend a Main Action and roll again to strike with the storm, dealing the same damage and pushing each affected creature 1 square away from the center where legal. Without that action the storm remains visible but deals no further damage that turn; it ends after the third round. Everyone in the sanctuary is exempt. Recasting ends the earlier storm.

nodes.name: Mass Lifegiving
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 uninterrupted hour · Reason · 10 SP, within a safe prepared sanctuary. Choose up to three willing dead people whose bodies are present and who died within the previous hour. Consume 200 coins of consecrated materials for each; the DA establishes availability beforehand. Restore their fatal injuries, return them to life at 1 HP and clear both death roll tallies. No roll. Scars remain; SP and Grit are not restored. Each person has one lifetime return to life, shared with Lifegiving and True Resurrection.

nodes.name: Foresight — Oracle’s Dream
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 hour of shared sleep · Reason · 6 SP. You and up to three willing nearby sleepers seek the help of a willing spirit for one named undertaking in the next 24 hours. The DA gives one truthful warning of a foreseeable obstacle and one usable clue about addressing it, subject to the spirit’s knowledge. Each dreamer may once reroll an entire roll directly addressing the undertaking and keep either result. Unused rerolls expire after 24 hours; a creature cannot hold a benefit from more than one Oracle’s Dream. No casting roll. This does not guarantee success or reveal unknowable future decisions.

nodes.name: Gate — World Anchor
nodes.effect: Ritual · 7 days, 8 hours of work per day · Knowledge · 10 SP on each workday, with prepared stone anchors at two known locations, each accessible during preparation, and 1,000 coins of materials consumed in total. The DA establishes availability and site permissions first. Create a permanent paired gateway, 2 squares wide, between those anchors, even across planes. At an anchor, a holder of either of the two keys you create can spend a Main Action and 3 SP to open both ends for 10 minutes, or a Maneuver to close them. Anyone can pass while open. A key conveys no control over travelers. Destroying either anchor ends the connection; each has 30 HP and physical resistance 3, and always takes at least 1 attack damage. No roll. You may maintain one pair; completing another ends the first.

nodes.name: Guards and Wards — Living Citadel
nodes.effect: Ritual · 3 days, 8 hours of work per day · Reason · 10 SP each day, with sound stone, fertile soil, water and 600 coins of materials consumed. On a prepared 12-by-12-square site, raise a one-story living keep with six rooms, a courtyard, a gate and walls 3 squares high. No roll. Walls block movement and sight; each 1-square section has 20 HP and physical resistance 3, with minimum 1 attack damage. You designate up to twelve residents. At dawn, paying 4 SP renews its wards for 24 hours: residents within gain 1 Boon to defenses, and you sense the location of any breached wall while inside. Missing upkeep removes the wards, not the building. The keep needs ordinary food, water and repairs. You may ward only one citadel at a time.

nodes.name: Another Tongue
nodes.duration: Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; choose one language when learned.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary language you do not already know. You can speak and understand it, and read and write its usual script if it has one. Record the language on your sheet. A signed language uses signing instead of speech. Choose from the campaign's ordinary languages with the DA. Secret and supernatural languages are learned through their own paths.

**Duration:** Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Duration:** Until the end of this turn; unused movement expires.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

nodes.name: Message by Heart
nodes.target: One message of up to 50 words that you can hear, or read in a script you know.
nodes.duration: Until you memorize a replacement message.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; one retained message at a time.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Time:** One minute of rehearsal.

**Target / range / shape:** One message of up to 50 words that you can hear, or read in a script you know.

After rehearsing the message for one minute, you can reproduce its words exactly from memory. You may retain unfamiliar words this way without understanding them. You can retain one message at a time; memorizing another replaces it. Recalling the stored message takes only the normal time to speak or write it. Translation and understanding come from your own knowledge or other abilities.

**Duration:** Until you memorize a replacement message.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Target / range / shape:** Self, while playing your chosen instrument.

When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary instrument you own, such as a lute, flute, drum, fiddle or horn. While you play that instrument, gain 1 Boon to any Guile roll. The instrument must be in your hands and in playing condition. The Boon can support performance, persuasion, deception and other Guile approaches that the music carries. Ordinary performance remains available to everyone; a performance with no uncertain consequence needs no roll.

**Duration:** While you play the chosen instrument.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires an ordinary Musical Instrument (Bulk 1), chosen when you learn this ability; grants none.

books.name: Ormund’s Codex of Stone & Deep Places
Serevan’s Book of Restoration
books.theme: Repair the body without bypassing recovery limits.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Thought
books.theme: Communication and bounded access to thought.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Emotion
books.theme: Influence feelings without dictating every decision.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Perception
books.theme: Illusions experienced by minds, not physical matter.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Dreams
books.theme: Sleep, dreams and their remembered impressions.

books.name: Orren’s Book of Farseeing
books.theme: Observe beyond ordinary reach through defined connections.

books.name: Orren’s Book of Echoes
books.theme: Read traces left by past events.

books.name: Vaelis’s Book of Spirits
books.theme: Contact incorporeal beings and understand hauntings.

books.name: Mordain’s Book of Shaping
books.theme: Reshape and repair existing nonliving material.

books.name: Mordain’s Book of Animation
books.theme: Give objects movement and bounded instructions.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Protection
books.theme: Protect an individual creature or object.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Sanctuary
books.theme: Protect places and establish safe boundaries.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Seals
books.theme: Secure doors, containers and magical workings.

books.name: Talven’s Book of Channeling
books.theme: Draw, give and redirect magical power between existing reserves. Casting costs are paid separately from the points you transfer.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Hurl a bright ember. Deal 2/3/5 fire damage.

spells.name: Boil Liquid
spells.target: One unattended container within 1 square; up to 10 liters
spells.effect: Bring its liquid to a rolling boil. The liquid then cools naturally; handle it with suitable protection.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.target: Every creature in a 3-square cone from you
spells.effect: Sweep your hands outward in a fan of flame. Deal 2/3/5 fire damage to each creature in the cone.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.target: One visible metal item worn or held within 6 squares
spells.effect: Heat the item until it glows. Its wearer or holder takes 2/3/5 fire damage when cast. Each later upkeep deals 1 fire damage to a creature still touching the item; this continuing heat is not an attack and resistance can reduce it to 0. A holder may drop it immediately after damage. Worn items take their normal removal time. The heat ends when Sustain ends.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 8 squares
spells.effect: Loose three fiery rays. Roll once for a shared total of 4/6/9 fire damage. Divide that total between the chosen targets before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each. Each target takes one damage event.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.target: A line of six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a wall of flame 2 squares high. Roll when cast to set its fire damage at 3/5/7. A creature takes that damage the first time each round it enters the wall or ends its turn there. Treat each creature once per round across all squares of this wall. Keep one Wall of Fire active; casting another ends the first.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst centered within 10 squares
spells.effect: A bead of fire bursts into a roaring sphere. Deal 3/5/8 fire damage to every creature in the burst, including allies. Exposed unattended flammable material ignites.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Wreathe yourself in protective heat. Gain cold resistance 2. A creature that damages you with an adjacent melee attack takes 2 fire damage after its attack resolves, once per attacker per round.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.target: Every creature in up to six connected squares within 10 squares
spells.effect: Trace a winding furnace across the battlefield. Deal 4/7/10 fire damage to each creature in the chosen squares. Each creature is affected once; exposed unattended flammable objects ignite.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.target: One visible point within 10 squares; 2-square-radius burst
spells.effect: Place a glowing bead at the point. On casting, or after a later upkeep, you may detonate it. Roll on detonation for 4/6/9 fire damage, adding 1 damage per completed upkeep, maximum +2. Ending sustain or touching the bead detonates it immediately. Every creature in the burst is affected once.

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.target: A 2-square-radius cloud centered within 8 squares
spells.effect: Fill the area with opaque, burning smoke. Roll when cast to set fire damage at 3/5/7. Creatures in it immediately take that damage. Thereafter a creature takes it on first entering or ending its turn there, at most once each round including the casting event. A Maneuver can move the cloud’s center up to 2 squares; entering a creature’s square counts as that creature entering the cloud. The cloud remains in place without that Maneuver. Keep one Incendiary Cloud active; casting another ends the first.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Send a needle of frost into the target. Deal 2/3/5 cold damage.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.target: An unattended open container or ground within 1 square
spells.effect: Create up to 10 liters of ordinary clean water or remove that quantity of free-standing water. Water inside living creatures and sealed vessels stays unchanged.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.target: Up to six meals and 10 liters of drinking water within 1 square
spells.effect: Remove ordinary spoilage, poison and disease from the chosen food and drink. The purified provisions remain subject to later contamination.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipients the ability to breathe water as readily as air. Their movement and pressure tolerance remain those of their bodies.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Let the recipients walk on calm or flowing liquid as though on firm ground, using normal movement. Waves and hazardous liquids retain their ordinary movement and damage effects. A recipient may end its own benefit with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.target: A 4-by-4-square area of existing water within 8 squares, up to 2 squares deep
spells.effect: Part, raise or redirect the water by up to 2 squares. Each upkeep can reshape it within that area. Swimming creatures move with the flow up to 2 squares each upkeep; a creature holding a fixed support stays in place. Released water returns to its natural course.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.duration: Instant; hail remains until your next turn ends
spells.effect: Hammer the area with sleet and hail. Deal 3/5/7 cold damage. The ground becomes difficult terrain until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a solid ice wall 2 squares high. Each square has 8 HP and physical resistance 1; fire damage uses its full value. A destroyed square opens a passage. Existing structures support the wall's weight.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.target: Every creature in a 4-square cone from you
spells.effect: Release a roaring blast of winter. Deal 4/6/9 cold damage and apply Freezing 1 to each creature in the cone.

spells.name: Freezing Sphere
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.effect: Burst a globe of intense cold for 4/7/10 cold damage. Exposed surface water in the area freezes into a walkable crust; a creature can break one adjacent ice square with a Main Action and a suitable tool.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.target: Every creature in a 5-square-wide, 3-square-long area within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a surging wave from nearby water or conjured spray. Deal 4/6/8 physical damage, push each affected creature 2 squares away from you, and make it Prone on Strong. Stability applies to the push; the water drains away after resolution.

spells.name: Enchanted Rope
spells.target: One unattended rope up to 6 squares long within 3 squares
spells.effect: Guide the rope's free end through a reachable opening and tie or undo one ordinary knot. It can secure itself to a suitable anchor. It bears its ordinary load and moves through unoccupied space.

spells.name: Loosen Earth
spells.target: One unoccupied square of loose earth within 3 squares, up to 1 square deep
spells.effect: Loosen, shift or pile the soil into an adjacent unoccupied square. Work around buried structures and roots. The resulting earth is ordinary material.

spells.name: Earthwall
spells.target: Three connected unoccupied ground squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise a bank of packed earth 1 square high. It provides cover and costs 2 movement to climb. Each bank square has 6 HP and physical resistance 1.

spells.name: Cracks Call
spells.target: One visible unoccupied 2-square section of stone within 6 squares
spells.effect: Split ordinary stone along an existing weakness. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a DA-set demolition objective declared before casting. Creatures supported by collapsing stone may use their normal falling responses. Magical barriers use their own removal procedures.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.target: Self; one adjacent natural stone mass large enough to hold you
spells.effect: Step inside the stone with your carried gear. You can hear muffled sounds and may emerge from your entry face with a Maneuver. While inside, rest and observe; manipulating the outside world requires emerging. If the stone is broken apart, emerge into the nearest open square and take 3 physical damage.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.target: One adjacent unattended stone mass, up to one square in each dimension
spells.effect: Reshape existing stone into a doorway, trough, steps or similarly simple form. Preserve its volume and structural support. Fine mechanisms require ordinary finishing work.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Harden the recipient's skin like weathered granite. It gains physical resistance 2, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares on solid ground within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a stone wall 2 squares high. Each section has 12 HP and physical resistance 2. It can include openings you shape when casting. At expiry the conjured stone crumbles into harmless dust.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.target: A 10-by-10-square patch of soil within 12 squares
spells.effect: Grade, trench or mound earth by up to 2 squares of depth or height. Shift it within the chosen patch, preserving volume. Move exposed loose soil around foundations rather than carrying buildings or creatures with it.

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of your next turn; conditions then decay normally
spells.effect: Stone creeps across the target. Apply Slowed 2/3/4. On Strong also apply Paralyzed 1. A second Strong casting while this spell's Slowed remains makes the target Petrified for 1 minute. Remove Curse, Greater Restoration or the caster's Maneuver ends that petrification.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.target: Every grounded creature in a 3-square-radius area within 10 squares
spells.effect: Shake the ground violently. Deal 4/6/8 physical damage and make affected creatures Prone. Add 2/4/6 progress toward one visible structure's DA-set collapse objective in the area; the DA describes unstable features before the roll.

spells.name: Elementalism — Air
spells.target: One unattended object of Bulk 0 within 3 squares
spells.effect: Stir a light breeze to turn pages, scatter loose dust, ring a small chime or move the object 1 square along a surface. The breeze can extinguish a candle-sized flame.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a creature begins falling
spells.target: One visible creature within 6 squares
spells.duration: Until it lands, up to 1 minute
spells.effect: A cushion of air slows the descent to 2 squares each round. The recipient lands upright and unharmed from this fall if the destination supports it.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.target: A 2-square-radius cloud centered within 6 squares
spells.effect: Gather an opaque bank of fog that blocks sight through its area. Strong wind disperses the cloud. Creatures may navigate by other senses and remembered positions.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.target: Every creature along a straight 6-square line from you
spells.effect: Drive a powerful gust along the line. Push each affected creature 1/2/3 squares away from you and disperse ordinary smoke or fog in the line. Stability applies to the push.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Lift the recipient up to 3 squares above its starting height. Each upkeep can raise or lower it 2 squares, keeping it within 6 squares of you. It can pull itself along reachable solid surfaces using movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares, then falls normally.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.target: Every creature along an 8-square line from you
spells.effect: Send a crackling stroke along the line. Deal 3/5/7 lightning damage to each creature, once each.

spells.name: Fly
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient flies using its normal Speed and movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares; remaining unsupported distance is a normal fall.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise a wind barrier 3 squares high. Physical ranged attacks through it receive 2 Banes. The wall disperses ordinary airborne smoke and gas in its squares. Creatures pass through at an extra movement cost of 1 per wall square.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.target: Up to four creatures within 10 squares; each within 3 squares of another target
spells.effect: Lightning leaps along your chosen chain. Roll once and deal 4/6/8 lightning damage to each target. Affect each creature once.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.target: The open sky within 1 kilometer of your ritual site
spells.effect: Gradually change local weather over the casting hour: clear or gather clouds, bring ordinary rain or snow, or raise or calm strong wind. Choose one weather change. Seasonal temperatures and sound shelter remain relevant. The change creates ordinary weather rather than attack damage.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Transform the company and carried gear into windborne mist. Each travels at Speed 12, can rise freely, and can speak to fellow travelers. Returning to solid form or mist takes 1 uninterrupted minute. While mist, use movement and observation; handling objects and casting require solid form. On expiry, choose the nearest safe ground within 6 squares.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.target: One adjacent Dying creature
spells.effect: Steady the creature's breathing. Stabilize it at 0 HP and clear both death roll tallies, following the normal stabilization procedure.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Close fresh injuries with a warm touch. Restore 3/5/7 HP, applying the recipient's Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.target: One living creature within 4 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Speak a brief word of renewal. Restore 1/2/3 HP, applying Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Choose Poisoned, Blinded or Deafened. Reduce its temporary rating by 1/2/3. This also treats a lasting instance whose source specifically names Lesser Restoration as its remedy.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.target: Up to six willing living creatures within 3 squares throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Guide a shared prayer of recovery. Roll once; each recipient restores 3/5/7 HP after Life resistance. Each creature can benefit from Prayer of Healing once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.target: Up to three living creatures within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Send a restoring word through your companions. Roll once; each restores 2/3/5 HP after Life resistance.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Choose one temporary condition; reduce it by 2/4/6. Alternatively, end one curse or lasting condition whose source names Greater Restoration as its remedy. That alternative is automatic and replaces the rolled reduction.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.target: Up to three living creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Weave wounds closed across a small company. Roll once; each restores 4/6/8 HP after Life resistance.

spells.name: Heal
spells.target: One living creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Flood the recipient with restorative power. Restore 8/12/16 HP after Life resistance and reduce both Bleeding and Poisoned by 2.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.target: One willing adjacent living creature throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Restore one missing nonvital limb or damaged ordinary sense, and restore 10 HP after Life resistance. The renewed part functions normally when the ritual finishes. Scars can remain as the player describes. This treats physical loss; curses use their named remedies.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.target: Up to six living creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Roll once for a shared healing total of 12/18/24 HP. Divide it among the chosen recipients, assigning at least 1 to each before Life resistance. Each recipient also reduces Bleeding by 2.

spells.name: Hues
spells.target: Self or one willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Change the color and pattern of hair, skin or fur. Choose ordinary or vivid colors. The recipient retains its silhouette, voice and other identifying features.

spells.name: Jump
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: The recipient's next jump can cover up to 4 squares horizontally or 2 vertically using its normal movement. Choose a reachable landing place and spend movement for the distance traveled.

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Increase the recipient's Speed by 2. Apply the highest magical Speed increase rather than adding repeated castings.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Choose one adaptation: gills for water breathing, webbing for swimming at normal Speed, or a changed face and voice. Keep your size and attributes. Changing the chosen adaptation requires another casting.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Living
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Change its size by one category, Small to Medium or Medium to Large, or the reverse. Adjust occupied space to 1 or 2 squares on each side as appropriate. Enlarged creatures gain Stability 1; reduced creatures gain 1 Boon to moving through tight spaces. Equipment changes with the body; attacks retain their printed damage.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient darkvision to 12 squares. It sees shapes in ordinary darkness; colors appear as shades of gray. Magical darkness follows its own visibility rules.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient the body of a familiar ordinary Small or Medium animal. It keeps its HP, attributes and mind. Choose walking, swimming or climbing at its normal Speed; use claws or a bite for Basic Unarmed attacks. Worn gear merges into the form. Returning costs a Maneuver; speech, item use and casting resume in the original body.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient moves through nonmagical difficult terrain at ordinary cost and immediately reduces Slowed by 3. Once each turn it may spend a Maneuver to reduce Grappled 1 or 2 by 2, using your movement magic to slip a loose hold. Grappled 3 requires release by the grappler or outside help.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Transform each recipient using Polymorph's animal-form procedure. Choose a form and movement mode separately for each. The fixed duration covers the group without Sustain. Each recipient may return to its original body with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Assume a familiar animal shape of Small, Medium or Large size. Keep your HP and attributes. Choose flying, swimming or climbing at your normal Speed, physical resistance 1, and a natural attack using Brawn or Agility for 3/5/7 physical damage. A Maneuver may change the form; otherwise it remains unchanged. Gear merges; return with a Maneuver to speak, use items or cast.

spells.name: True Polymorph — Living
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature; 100 coins of transformative incense consumed
spells.effect: Shape an ordinary living body of Small or Medium size: a humanoid guise or familiar animal. The recipient keeps its mind, HP and attributes. Choose one movement adaptation: swimming or climbing at normal Speed, or flight at Speed 4. Animal bodies use Polymorph's equipment and action rules. The recipient may return with a Maneuver; Greater Restoration also ends the transformation.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.target: One ordinary plant or patch of soil within 3 squares
spells.effect: Open a flower, ripen one already-growing fruit, make a seed sprout, or read whether rain is likely here in the next day. The growth affects one hand-sized part of the plant.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.target: Every grounded creature in a 2-square-radius area within 6 squares
spells.effect: Roots grasp through soil. Apply Slowed 1/2/3 to creatures in the area when cast. The area is difficult terrain while sustained. Each upkeep renews Slowed 1 on those originally caught who remain in the area. A conscious caught creature may spend a Main Action to escape; success removes this casting’s Slowed and protects it from being caught again by the same casting. Leaving the area or ending Sustain also removes this casting’s Slowed. Difficult terrain remains while the roots persist.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.target: Up to six ordinary berries held by you
spells.effect: Each berry nourishes one creature for one meal when eaten. A berry is consumed by eating it and retains its ordinary Bulk. Food and hunger use this nourishment; HP recovery follows healing spells and treatment.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.target: One ordinary plant within 1 square
spells.effect: Converse through impressions of light, weather, touch and nearby movement experienced during the past day. Ask up to three questions. The DA answers from what this plant could sense.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.target: A 2-square-radius patch of soil within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise sharp growth that makes the area difficult terrain. Roll when cast to set physical damage at 2/3/5. Each creature takes that damage the first time each round it moves through at least one affected square. The growth is visible on inspection. Keep one Spike Growth active; casting another ends the first.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.target: A 6-by-6-square patch of existing ordinary vegetation within 6 squares
spells.effect: Thicken the plants into difficult terrain. You may leave a connected walking path clear when casting. Alternatively, tend the same area for healthy seasonal growth; that use improves its next ordinary harvest rather than creating immediate food.

spells.name: Tree Skin
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Bark covers the recipient's skin. Grant physical resistance 2 and Stability 1. Use the highest applicable resistance and Stability.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.target: Self; one adjacent living tree large enough to admit you
spells.effect: Step through the tree and emerge beside another living tree you can see within 12 squares. Carry your worn and held equipment. Choose an unoccupied destination with firm support.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.target: One willing ordinary animal or living tree beside you; 100 coins of rare incense consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a speaking mind with one language you know. The being keeps its body, natural senses and ordinary capabilities. It becomes an independent person; agree on any companionship or service through conversation. You can complete this awakening once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied ground squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Grow a thorn wall 2 squares high. Moving through one square costs 3 movement and deals 3/5/7 physical damage, set by your casting roll, once per creature each round. Each wall square has 8 HP; fire damages it normally.

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures beside a living tree
spells.effect: Travel through the tree to another living tree you personally touched within the past month, up to 10 kilometers away on the same plane. Everyone emerges in safe adjacent squares with carried gear. The destination tree must remain alive and large enough to admit a traveler.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.target: One living creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Exhale a stinging spray. Deal 2/3/5 poison damage.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.target: One living creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Strike with a sickly ray for 2/3/5 poison damage. On Strong also apply Poisoned 1.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Draw vigor from the target's muscles. Apply Slowed 1/2/3; on Strong also apply Dazed 1.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Grant poison resistance 2 and immediately reduce Poisoned by 2. Apply the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Take strength through a withering touch. Deal 2/4/6 life damage. Restore your HP by the damage actually dealt, up to 2/4/6, after applying your own Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Speak a curse that burdens its efforts. Apply Poisoned 1/2/3, representing magical frailty, with ordinary decay. While the curse persists, you may spend a Maneuver to renew Poisoned 1 on that target, once on your turn; this costs 0 SP. Remove Curse ends the curse and its remaining contribution immediately. You may have one Bestow Curse active; casting it again ends the earlier curse.

spells.name: Blight
spells.target: One living creature or plant within 8 squares
spells.effect: Wither flesh or foliage for 4/6/9 life damage. An ordinary unattended plant fitting within one square dries into brittle matter.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Inflict Poisoned 1/2/3*. This magical sickness persists at that rating until you end it with a Maneuver, Lesser Restoration treats it, or a successful 10-minute Knowledge treatment reaches 3 progress at 1/2/3 per attempt. It fades after 10 minutes in any case.

spells.name: Harm
spells.target: One living creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Deal 5/8/11 life damage and apply Poisoned 1. Resolve damage and dying by the ordinary rules.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.target: One living creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: A black pulse strikes for 6/9/12 life damage. If the target reaches 0 HP, resolve its ordinary dying rules; the spell's damage is one event.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.target: Every living creature in a 3-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.effect: A ring of pallor spreads from the chosen point. Deal 4/6/8 life damage to each creature in the burst, including allies.

spells.name: Message
spells.target: One creature you can see within 6 squares
spells.effect: Whisper a message of up to ten words into the recipient's hearing. It may answer with up to ten words as part of the exchange. The message travels through ordinary ambient noise.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.target: Self; spoken words heard or writing touched
spells.effect: Understand the literal meaning of one language at a time. Read at an ordinary pace. Cultural references, ciphers and deliberate codes retain their own interpretation challenges.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares that you can see
spells.effect: Read surface impressions. Learn 1/2/3 immediate concerns or sensory impressions, chosen by the DA for an NPC or its player for a hero. The target senses the intrusion after the reading. Deep memories use stronger workings.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient can understand and speak the ordinary languages of creatures addressing it. Its voice remains its own. Reading and writing use languages it already knows.

spells.name: Sending
spells.target: One creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Send up to twenty-five words through a mental thread. The recipient knows who sent it and may answer with twenty-five words. A creature that chooses silence still receives the message.

spells.name: Telepathic Bond
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Create a shared mental conversation reaching 1 kilometer. Participants exchange words and simple images by intent while conscious. Each participant may leave the link at any time.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: 10 minutes of conversation; altered memory lasts until restored
spells.effect: Help the recipient replace or soften one memory covering up to five minutes of a real event. It chooses the replacement account with you. Add 1/2/3 progress toward target 3, with each further conversation attempt taking a Main Action and a new casting. At completion the altered recollection becomes its remembered account. Greater Restoration or a matching consensual working restores the original.

spells.name: Inner Thoughts
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Read a thought connected to one question you speak aloud. Learn 1/2/3 relevant images or associations from its present thinking. The recipient knows the question and intrusion; responses remain bounded by its actual knowledge.

spells.name: Mind Scan
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Search one area of its remembered experience together. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a DA-set recollection objective. The subject chooses which memories to explore and can halt the ritual.

spells.name: Mind Probe
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Press into a guarded thought. Deal 3/5/7 mental damage and learn one immediate intention the target is considering. For a hero, its player states that intention. The target recognizes your intrusion.

spells.name: Thought Steal
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Borrow one ordinary language or one factual recollection the subject agrees to share. You can use it for the duration; the subject retains it. Record the exact knowledge gained. Learned abilities and SP remain with their owner.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Turn a cutting phrase into a psychic sting. Deal 2/3/5 mental damage.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Bolster its courage. Reduce Frightened by 2 immediately and grant 1 Boon to rolls made while confronting a visible source of fear.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares that can hear and understand you
spells.duration: Until the social exchange ends, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Offer an appealing introduction. Add 1/2/3 progress toward an attainable social objective involving a friendly hearing or small favor. During the exchange, the target senses you as approachable. The DA establishes the concession and its boundaries before casting.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Send a steadying hush through the group. Reduce each target's Frightened by 1/2/3. Willing listeners may also pause an argument long enough for one person to speak.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that understands your words
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Frame a specific, feasible course of action that appeals to the target. Add 2/3/4 progress toward the DA's stated persuasion objective. Each further casting needs a new relevant reason or changed circumstance, following social progress rules.

spells.name: Fear
spells.target: Every creature in a 3-square cone that can perceive you
spells.effect: Appear as an overwhelming source of dread. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, with you as its source. Each creature retains control of its movement and decisions.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares able to understand an offered image or emotion
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Establish rapport through shared sensations even across a language barrier. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a feasible request stated by the DA. The creature's needs and motives shape what you can ask of it.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Scatter attention with conflicting impulses. Apply Dazed 1/1/2. Each affected creature chooses its remaining action categories normally when its turn begins.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.target: Up to six creatures within 6 squares that understand you and share a motive
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Propose one common course of action. Add 3/5/7 progress toward a single attainable group objective. The DA sets the concession and boundaries before casting. A later attempt needs a new relevant contribution.

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that understands you
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: State one brief command: move to a named safe place, release a held object, or perform one ordinary interaction. On its turn the target chooses to perform that command using its own actions or suffer Dazed 1/2/3 from resisting the pressure. Once that choice resolves, the command ends.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spells.target: One fixed object or 3-square-radius place within reach
spells.effect: Choose a recognizable group and either welcome or dread. When a matching creature first enters, it feels the chosen pull and recognizes it as magic. Welcome supplies 1 Boon to your group's first relevant social contribution there; dread applies Frightened 1/2/3, set by your ritual roll, once per creature. Identify the object or place as the fear source.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.target: One point within 6 squares; a sound or still image fitting one square
spells.effect: Create a simple sound or stationary visual image. An image is insubstantial; a sound can be as loud as ordinary speech. Physical interaction reveals the illusion. You can keep one Minor Illusion at a time.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.target: An image fitting a 2-by-2-square space within 6 squares
spells.effect: Shape a silent moving image. A Maneuver may move it up to 3 squares and alter its gestures. Physical interaction reveals its insubstantial nature; observers may examine it using the shared illusion procedure. Without directing it, the image stays in place and repeats its last simple performance.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Change your apparent face, clothing and proportions within your existing size. Your voice and tangible shape remain physical. Touch reveals mismatches; close inspection uses the shared illusion procedure.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.target: Self
spells.duration: 1 minute or until three attacks resolve against you
spells.effect: Create three shifting doubles. Gain 1 Boon to defenses against attacks that depend on seeing you. After each such attack resolves, one double vanishes. The remaining doubles provide the same single Boon.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Make the recipient and its carried gear Invisible. Attacking or casting another spell ends this casting's invisibility after that action resolves. Other senses can still locate the recipient.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.target: An image fitting a 3-by-3-square space within 8 squares
spells.effect: Create a moving illusion with sound, scent and harmless temperature. A Maneuver can move it 3 squares and change its performance. Touch reveals its insubstantial nature. It may conceal a real feature visually; physical terrain remains as it was. Without directing it, the image stays in place and repeats its last simple performance.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Make the recipient and carried gear Invisible. It may continue attacking and casting while this effect lasts. Attacking still reveals its location and ends Hidden normally.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.target: A fixed 10-by-10-square outdoor area within 10 squares
spells.effect: Change the area's apparent plants, surfaces and small terrain features. Buildings and creatures retain their appearance. Real footing remains physical; touch or travel through a mismatch reveals it, and observation uses the illusion procedure.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.target: Self and an illusory double within 6 squares
spells.effect: Become Invisible while creating a visible, speaking double of yourself. A Maneuver may move the double 3 squares and choose whether you see and hear from your own position or the double’s until your next turn. Without directing it, the double stays still and repeats its last simple performance; your senses remain at your own body. Attacking ends your invisibility after resolution but leaves the double until expiry. Keep one Mislead casting active.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.target: Up to six willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give each recipient an apparent humanoid disguise using Disguise Self's limits. Design each disguise when casting. Each recipient may dismiss its own disguise with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.target: One fixed 3-by-3-square space within reach
spells.effect: Prepare a visual and audible performance lasting up to 1 minute. State a visible or audible trigger within 6 squares when casting. The first matching event plays the recorded illusion once. Physical interaction reveals it; afterward the spell ends.

spells.name: Dreams
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature within 1 square
spells.effect: Share one brief harmless dream image or soothing sensation. The sleeper later remembers it as a dream. Ordinary waking ends the exchange.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.target: One creature within 4 squares
spells.effect: Send drowsiness over the target. Apply Slowed 1/2/3; on Strong also apply Asleep 1. Damage or ordinary waking procedures end Asleep.

spells.name: Dream Message
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Appear in a short dream and exchange up to fifty words each. The recipient recognizes you and remembers the conversation on waking. The ritual reaches the subject only while it is asleep.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Create a troubling sensory image that only the target perceives. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, naming the image as its source. Each upkeep renews Frightened 1. Physical contact or a completed illusion examination exposes it and ends its fear contribution. A conscious target may also spend a Main Action to reject the image using the printed hold and escape attributes. Escape or ending Sustain removes this casting’s fear contribution.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.target: Up to three creatures in a 2-square-radius area within 8 squares that can see the pattern
spells.effect: Weave a mesmerizing display. Apply Dazed 1/1/2 to each chosen target. Sight is required when the spell resolves.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Make a private nightmare seem to strike. Deal 3/5/7 mental damage and apply Frightened 1, with the nightmare as its source until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Dream
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Meet in a shared dream with speech and vivid images. Each participant can recall the exchange afterward. The dream ends if either wakes; you can show remembered experiences as you recall them.

spells.name: Sign of Sleep
spells.target: One visible mark on an object within reach
spells.effect: The first creature to read or closely examine the mark receives Slowed 2/3/4 and Asleep 1/1/2, set by your casting roll. Its appearance suggests a magical inscription. Damage or waking ends Asleep normally. The mark triggers once.

spells.name: Lord Dream
spells.target: Self and up to five willing sleepers within 3 squares
spells.effect: Host a shared dream with chosen scenery and conversation. Participants may practice, exchange memories or plan together. Each receives 1 Boon on its first roll directly implementing one agreed plan within 24 hours; record that plan before waking.

spells.name: Weird
spells.target: Up to six creatures within 8 squares
spells.effect: Surround the targets with personalized waking terrors. Roll once; each takes 3/5/7 mental damage and gains Frightened 2, with the visions as source until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.target: Self and up to three willing creatures beside you
spells.effect: Send visible spirit projections into the nearby spirit realm while bodies sleep. Projections travel together up to 1 kilometer from the bodies, speak with spirits and observe corresponding places. They return when the spell ends or a body is disturbed. Projections use observation and speech; physical acts and further casting take place after returning to the bodies.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.target: One visible object or creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Sense whether an active magical effect is present on the target. Learn whether the strongest visible aura is protective, transformative, harmful or informative. Closely concealed sources require examination through stronger pages.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.target: Food, drink or one willing creature within 1 square
spells.effect: Determine whether ordinary poison or disease is present and identify its broad type: ingested, inhaled, contact or bodily infection. The reading helps select suitable treatment.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.target: Visible creatures or objects within 6 squares
spells.effect: Perceive the presence of summoned forms, undead and active spirit bindings. Learn which visible targets bear those properties. Their motives are discovered through interaction.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.target: One visible 3-by-3-square area within 6 squares
spells.effect: Sense intentionally prepared mechanisms or magical triggers that could harm an entrant. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a search objective set by the DA. At completion identify each detected trigger's location and how it is activated; disarming uses its own procedure.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See Invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as translucent outlines. This satisfies visual targeting at that distance; solid cover still blocks sight.

spells.name: Identify
spells.target: One adjacent object examined throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Learn 1/2/3 facts about its active magical properties, chosen from activation, charges or costs, duration, and an explicit drawback. The DA gives accurate facts available from the item's current enchantment.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Within 6 squares, see Invisible targets and perceive the original outline beneath visual illusions or disguising magic. You recognize illusion as illusion while retaining sight of the underlying scene. Solid barriers retain their normal visibility limits.

spells.name: Analysis
spells.target: One adjacent object, creature or fixed magical effect
spells.effect: Add 2/4/6 progress toward understanding one magical effect, with target 6. Each completed analysis reveals its purpose, remaining duration, whether it requires Sustain and one named remedy or interruption method. Use further castings for further effects.

spells.name: Detect Magic — Scaling Analysis
spells.target: Up to three visible magical sources within 6 squares
spells.effect: Read their relative strength. Learn each source's spell name if known, its SP cost or equivalent strength, and its remaining duration on Standard or Strong; Weak reveals only the strongest source and whether it is sustained. Choose all targets before rolling.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.target: Self; a known fixed destination within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Sense the direction of an ordinary traversable route to a location you previously visited. At each junction, learn which way continues along that route. Terrain and locks still require ordinary travel and interaction; if no traversable route exists, the reading identifies the nearest obstruction.

spells.name: Sight True
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See Invisible targets and recognize visual illusions within 12 squares. Also see the outlines of creatures immediately beyond ordinary cover up to 1 square thick, within 6 squares. Such outlines reveal position; attacks still require a clear path.

spells.name: Nightsight
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See clearly in dim light within 6 squares. In complete darkness, perceive only shapes already illuminated by a light source.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.target: One visible point within 12 squares
spells.effect: Place an invisible stationary sensor. Choose sight or hearing when casting; spend a Main Action to use that sense from the sensor until your next turn starts. Your own corresponding sense is occupied during that interval.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.target: One familiar object within 100 squares
spells.effect: Sense its direction while holding an item of the same material. Choose a specific object you have handled or the nearest example of a common kind. Magical concealment expressly blocking divination stops the signal.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.target: One creature you personally know within 100 squares
spells.effect: Sense its direction and whether it is moving closer or farther away. You need a personal possession it used within the last month. The reading follows the creature's current body.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.target: One sensor initially within 3 squares; remains within 12 squares
spells.effect: Create a tiny visible glimmering eye. A Maneuver moves it up to 4 squares through open passages; otherwise it stays in place. Spend a Main Action to see from it until your next turn begins. The sensor has 1 HP and uses your Agility for player-rolled defenses.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.target: One consenting creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Receive an image and sound of the space within 3 squares of the subject. Weak gives one brief glimpse, Standard up to thirty seconds, Strong the full minute. The subject senses your presence and may end the connection.

spells.name: Long Ear
spells.target: One point you have visited within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Place a stationary listening sensor. Spend a Main Action to listen from it until your next turn begins. It hears ordinary sounds within 6 squares of that point, subject to intervening barriers and noise.

spells.name: Watch II
spells.target: Two fixed points within 12 squares
spells.effect: Mark two observation points. While within 12 squares of either, you may spend a Main Action to see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Switching points takes another Main Action. Each viewpoint follows normal line of sight and hearing.

spells.name: Watch True
spells.target: Up to four fixed points you have visited within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Prepare a network of stationary observation points. A Main Action lets you see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Choose a different point with another Main Action. Magical concealment and ordinary barriers operate at each viewpoint.

spells.name: Long Sense
spells.target: One point you have visited within 10 kilometers
spells.effect: Send sight and hearing to that fixed location. Spend a Main Action each round to observe until your next turn begins. While observing, your own sight and hearing rest at the remote point; touch can still alert you to nearby contact.

spells.name: Long Sense True
spells.target: One willing creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Establish a remote sensory link. While both consent, use a Main Action to share what it sees and hears until your next turn begins. It continues using its own senses normally and may end the link at any time.

spells.name: Origins
spells.target: One unattended object held in your hands
spells.effect: Sense its principal ordinary material and whether it was grown, shaped, mined or assembled. This gives a useful starting point for further investigation.

spells.name: Past Visions
spells.target: One adjacent fixed place or unattended object
spells.effect: Receive 1/2/3 sensory impressions of its most recent notable event within the past day. The DA presents concrete sights, sounds or touches from that event.

spells.name: Power Lore
spells.target: One adjacent magical object
spells.effect: Learn 1/2/3 historical facts about how its enchantment was made or previously used. Facts concern its actual history, not current activation instructions unless the remembered event demonstrates them.

spells.name: Item Vision
spells.target: One object held throughout the ritual
spells.effect: See a brief scene involving its most recent owner within the last month. Weak reveals the owner's appearance, Standard also the scene's surroundings, and Strong also one spoken exchange of up to twenty words.

spells.name: Vision Guide
spells.target: One adjacent site
spells.effect: Ask how one visible trace came to be here. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a historical inquiry objective, target 3. At completion see the event that left that trace, if it occurred within the last year.

spells.name: Delving
spells.target: One adjacent object or ruin
spells.effect: Add 2/4/6 progress toward uncovering one named part of its history, target 6. At completion learn who made it, its intended purpose, and one subsequent event relevant to your question, reaching back up to a century.

spells.name: Vision Location
spells.target: One object held; its former location within 10 kilometers
spells.effect: See the surroundings where the object spent the longest uninterrupted time during the last month. Learn the direction and approximate distance from your present location if that place lies within range.

spells.name: Past Store
spells.target: One held crystal or polished stone
spells.effect: Store up to one minute of what you personally see and hear during the ritual. A later Main Action holding the stone plays the memory as a small shared image and sound. The stone holds one recording; you may keep three prepared stones.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.target: One adjacent historic object or site; 25 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Ask one question about an important event in its history. Weak reveals one truthful clue, Standard a brief accurate account, and Strong the account plus a practical lead to evidence or another witness. The DA draws from the object's real past.

spells.name: Past Truth
spells.target: One adjacent site and one specific event within the past year
spells.effect: View up to ten minutes of that event from a fixed point at the site. The vision shows what happened there, including audible speech. Magical concealment that obscured the event remains part of the vision.

spells.name: Vision Behind — Ages
spells.target: One adjacent ancient site; 100 coins of rare incense consumed
spells.effect: Explore one named event up to a thousand years old. Add 3/5/7 progress toward target 7. At completion witness up to one hour from a fixed position and learn one surviving location or object connected to it. Each further attempt requires a new ritual and its costs.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.defense: Brawn against a melee weapon; Agility against a ranged weapon
spells.defenseAttribute: Brawn against a melee weapon; Agility against a ranged weapon
spells.target: One adjacent creature with a melee weapon, or one visible creature within 8 squares with a ranged weapon
spells.effect: Follow a brief vision of the opening to come. Make one weapon attack using Reason and deal 2/3/5 physical damage. Use the weapon's ordinary hand and ammunition requirements.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: Until its next roll or your next turn ends
spells.effect: Offer a useful flash of intuition. Give 1 Boon to the recipient's next non-attack task roll. A creature can hold one Guidance benefit at a time.

spells.name: Augury
spells.target: One course of action you intend to begin within 10 minutes
spells.effect: Ask whether the contemplated course is likely to bring benefit, danger, both or neither during the next hour. The DA answers from current circumstances. New decisions can change the outcome. Ask once per distinct proposed course between overnight rests.

spells.name: Intuitions
spells.actionText: Reaction · before you roll a defense
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: A momentary warning sharpens your response. Gain 1 Boon to that defense.

spells.name: Anticipations I
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Read the next immediate threat. Once during the duration, gain 2 Boons to one defense you declare before rolling. The spell ends when you use that benefit.

spells.name: Spell Anticipations
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster begins a spell targeting you
spells.trigger: when a visible caster begins a spell targeting you
spells.target: Self; caster within 8 squares
spells.effect: Recognize its magical approach. Learn the spell's action, damage type or principal condition before choosing any remaining response. Gain 1 Boon to your defense against that spell.

spells.name: Divination
spells.target: One specific undertaking planned for the next day
spells.effect: Seek a warning. Weak reveals one relevant omen, Standard adds a concrete obstacle, and Strong adds a practical way to prepare. The DA describes possibilities based on present circumstances, not a compulsory future.

spells.name: Commune
spells.target: One spiritual patron or source with which you have an established relationship
spells.effect: Ask up to three questions answerable by yes, no or uncertain. Answers reflect that source's knowledge and may be uncertain where events or secrets exceed it. You can seek this communion once between safe overnight rests.
